name: International Neuropsychological Society 55th Annual Meeting 2027 (INS Boston 2027)
description: The 55th Annual Meeting of the International Neuropsychological Society is held in Boston under the theme From Neurocircuits to People. Submissions include posters, papers and symposia, with a late breaking poster session on Saturday 13 February 2027.
